preview.orzo.title: Lemon orzo with golden zucchini
preview.orzo.body: Bright lemon, a little parmesan, and one pan. An easy favourite for the evenings in between.
preview.orzo.step1: Slice the zucchini. In a lightly oiled pan, cook until golden on both sides.
preview.orzo.step2: Stir in the orzo and stock. Simmer gently, stirring often, until the pasta is tender. Add a splash of water if needed.
preview.orzo.step3: Take off the heat. Fold in the parmesan, lemon zest and a squeeze of lemon juice. Season to taste and serve.
preview.toast.title: Tomatoes on sourdough
preview.toast.body: Ripe tomatoes, crisp toast, and the good olive oil.
preview.toast.step1: Toast the bread until crisp. Chop the tomatoes and toss with the olive oil.
preview.toast.step2: Spoon the tomatoes onto the toast. Season to taste and serve straight away.
preview.rice.title: Miso mushrooms & rice
preview.rice.body: Deeply savoury mushrooms. A bowl to settle into.
preview.rice.step1: Cook the rice in water according to the packet instructions. Slice the mushrooms.
preview.rice.step2: Sear the mushrooms in a lightly oiled pan. Loosen the miso with a little warm water, stir it through, and serve over the rice.
